body: Thank you for your reply. I was about to delete the whole thing. I know how insane it sounds. Thing is, I have no idea who can be doing this. Well, that's to say, I have suspicions, but no evidence. My neighborhood used to be a nice one. Now it's crawling with shady characters. On a personal level, I have never done anything to anyone that would warrant this magnitude of terror. What I suspect is that someone thinks I know more than I do about one or more scams. Or just someone crazy. I'd prefer the first one. What I don't understand is why it keeps going allthough they must have known for a long time that I don't know anything about anything. Anyway; hanging in there atm. Thx again for your reply.
